ItemID: unavailable; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in older folk-pop and classic hits than contemporary ballads right now.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adele is not my priority while I am browsing for older favorites.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Superhits: Paul Davis; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The mellow pop sound could suit me, but I would pick Bread and Neil Diamond first.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Best of Bowie; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not seeking Bowie's more theatrical rock sound during this visit.
